[EN] Things are getting out of hand! The {@LinkCreature:22#10#senior apprentices} tried to kill me!

These are no mewing children content with a flash and a pop. These young witches actually have some power.

There are too many to leave them in control of the halls. Stop them quickly or there'll be no cakes today.
[ES] ¡Las cosas se están saliendo de control! ¡Los {@LinkCreature:22#10#senior apprentices} intentaron matarme!

Estos no son niños maulladores conformes con un destello y un estallido. Estas jóvenes brujas realmente tienen algo de poder.

Hay demasiados para dejarles el control de los pasillos. Detenlos rápido o no habrá pasteles hoy.

[EN] Whomever is behind this nightmare will pay with pain most exquisite. It will take them months to die!

Your decisiveness is appreciated, . If everyone was in their right minds, they'd thank you.
[ES] Quien esté detrás de esta pesadilla pagará con el dolor más exquisito. ¡Les tomará meses morir!

Se agradece tu determinación, . Si todos estuvieran en su sano juicio, te lo agradecerían.
